name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe (Cars Land) Ka-Cheeseburger (Plain Mod) or Roasted Turkey Club
brandOrRestaurant: Flo's V8 Cafe (Cars Land · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Flo's 1950s diner in Cars Land serves a classic 1/3-lb Angus cheeseburger with aged cheddar on a soft bun (plus a Kids' Micro Burger) and thin-cut steak fries.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Ka-Cheeseburger (or Kids' Burger) with cheddar cheese only—hold the 1000 Island dressing, caramelized onions, lettuce, and pickles—and pair with steak fries or a mandarin-free fruit side.
watchOuts: Do NOT eat the cutaneous/citrus Mandarin Oranges that come with Disney Kids' Meals (citrus trigger)—swap for fries or applesauce
